input.title: =map
input.body:
Combine two trees:

```js
(Tree, Tree) => Tree
``` 

## Example

content =
- a
  - b
    - c

styles =
- x
  - `=style`
    - color
      - red
  - y
    - `=style`
      - border
        - solid 1px red

f(content, styles) =
- a
  - `=style`
    - color
      - red
  - b
    - `=style`
      - border
        - solid 1px red
    - c

## Alternative Names

- map
- merge
- overlay 
- reduce

## Requirements

- Should it assume the two trees are the same shape? Or should the mapping made more explicit and arbitrary?
- May provide an alternative implementation to `=children` and `=grandchildren`. 
- Push vs Pull
  - Push - Initiate from source
  - Pull - Initiate at destination
